run.method: stem-recovery and expansion-ambiguity adversary: blends, compact forms, language stewardship
run.brief: Create a valid schema_version 1 identity portfolio for DSEx with run id run-19b-form-blends-compact-language, atlas_version 1, generator kind model/name form saturation generator E/provider openai/model gpt-5.4/reasoning_effort high/agent_id null, method stem-recovery and expansion-ambiguity adversary: blends, compact forms, language stewardship, parent_run_ids [], and run notes including challenge_wave: form-saturation-b, independent baseline-blind generation, and the three challenge cells. Respect the product boundary of a pre-release Elixir/OTP library for declared, callable, measurable, optimizable LM programs with a credible artifact horizon spanning instructions, demonstrations, tool descriptions, retrieval policies, playbooks, schemas, code fragments, and configuration, while avoiding claims that it is an official DSPy port, static proof system, universal agent OS, provider SDK, guaranteed autonomous self-improvement system, safety product, standards body, institute, or universal platform. Generate exactly 30 candidates with contiguous ordinals and preserve every output: 1-10 true-blends across composition-modularity and writing-editing-publishing using compound-portmanteau and/or coined-category-noun for backend-product-engineers and educators-writers with recoverable stems and explicit distinction among overlap blend, compound, affixation, and typo; 11-20 compact-forms across persistence-provenance and measurement-evidence using acronym-initialism and/or technical-borrowing for eval-research-ops, pl-researchers, and international-users while testing abbreviation, initialism, pronounceable acronym, wordlike acronym, dual reading, and deliberately contestable backronym and stating whether expansion is recoverable; 21-30 source-language-stewardship across language-semantics and civic-governance using archaic-cross-language and/or ordinary-object for international-users, affected-publics, and educators-writers with one named source language each, no fabricated relay hybrids, and recorded source uncertainty, transliteration, pronunciation, social context, and not-verified reviewer status, never claiming permission or acceptance. Make every candidate include non-null pronunciation and grammar, honest etymology or coined/no-source text, nonempty valid audience_lenses and architecture_lenses, rationale, concerns, and notes. Ensure notes include separate challenge_wave, challenge_cell, form_mechanism, stance, scope, code_projection, current_embodiment, and horizon_embodiment strings. code_projection must give all six forms or a precise non-code role plus viable linked implementation. Use exactly 6 wildcard true, exactly 2 per cell. Make each cell exactly 5 affirmative; true-blends and source-language-stewardship each with 3 ambivalent and 2 adverse, compact-forms with 2 ambivalent and 3 adverse. Make each cell exactly 4 current, 4 horizon, and 2 both. Use only valid atlas IDs.
